cards.imageAlt: 轻型飞机迫降，用于本话题的看图描述和问答
cards.taskTitle: 轻型飞机迫降 · 看图材料

cards.audioText: Can you tell me what happened in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否描述下图中发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: OK, in this picture, I can see an aircraft crashes into a truck on a mountain road.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，在这幅图里，我看到一架飞机在山路上和一辆汽车相撞。

cards.audioText: What do you think might have caused this accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得造成这一事故的可能原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: I think this accident happened mostly due to weather. From the smoke and trees in the picture I can see there was strong wind. It's common to meet unstable air flow in the mountain area, so the airplane possibly encountered wind shear or strong wind. If the pilot could not control the plane well under such condition, crash was easily to happen.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为这一事故很可能是由于天气问题。从图中烟和树的形态可以看出有强风。在山区很容易遇到不稳定气流，所以这架飞机很可能是遇到了风切变或者强风。遇到这种情况时，如果飞行员不能很好地控制飞机，很有可能发生碰撞。

cards.audioText: How can this kind of accidents be prevented?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何预防这类事故发生？
cards.referenceText: To prevent this situation from happening, pilots should be more careful in mountain area flight. If they encountered bad weather, they'd better try to choose a safe and broad place, far away from the crowd, to land the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 为了预防这种情况发生，飞行员在山区飞行时应更加小心。如果遇到恶劣天气，他们最好尽量选择一个安全开阔、远离人群的地方降落。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered wind shear? Why are they a danger?
cards.audioTextZh: 你遇到过风切变么？为什么说风切变很危险？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. Wind shear is a difference in wind speed and direction over a relatively short distance in the atmosphere. If the direction is downward, an abrupt drop in altitude will occur before the pilot can compensate. Any sudden significant change in wind direction can lead to a loss of control, potentially causing crash. Some wind shear can cause structural damage to the aircraft. Mainly, Wind shear brings greatest danger to aircraft during takeoff and landing. Many airports suffer the effects of wind shear, although wind shear has been recognized in aviation, it is still not fully understood till now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我遇到过。/不，我没遇到过。风切变是风速和风向在空中相对较短的距离上的变化。如果风向向下，飞行高度会迅速下降，而飞行员根本来不及补救。风向发生任何大的改变都会让飞机失去控制，甚至可能毁坏。有些风切变会毁坏飞机结构。重要的是，起飞和降落阶段风切变都会对飞机造成很大的伤害。许多机场都深受风切变的影响，尽管风切变已经广为人知，但至今都未被完全了解。

cards.audioText: How would you deal with wind shear if you were confronted by it in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行时遇到风切变你会如何处理？
cards.referenceText: If I encountered wind shear in flight, I will notify ATC what I have encountered and request radar vector. And then I will perform the Wind Shear Escape Maneuver in the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞行时遇到风切变，我会通知ATC该情况并请求雷达引导。之后我会按照检查单内的风切变改出执行。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me any incident of ground collision between aircraft and vehicle?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否告诉我一些飞机和车辆在地面相撞的事故么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. A ground collision happened between an aircraft and a shuttle bus at Beijing airport several years ago. The aircraft was being pushed back, while the shuttle bus was just passing behind it. I think it is maybe the mistake made by the controller; he didn't give the right instruction to the pilot. Finally, the shuttle bus hit on the tail of the aircraft. Fortunately, nobody was injured in that accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。几年前在北京机场一架飞机和摆渡车发生地面碰撞。飞机当时正在推出，而摆渡车刚好从后方经过。我觉得这可能是管制员的失误造成的，他给了飞行员错误的指令。最终，摆渡车撞到了机尾。幸运的是，这场事故中没人受伤。

cards.audioText: Tell me some hazardous conditions on the ground that might affect the safety of the flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉我一些可能影响飞行安全的地面危险情况。
cards.referenceText: OK. There are many hazardous conditions on the ground that may affect flight safety. For example, low visibility, contaminated runway, displaced threshold, animals and vehicles crossing the runway, construction work near the runway, and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。影响飞行安全的地面危险情况有很多。例如低能见度、污染的跑道、跑道入口内移、动物及车辆横穿跑道、跑道附近正在施工等。

cards.audioText: Tell me some hazardous conditions in air that might affect the safety of the flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉我一些可能影响飞行安全的空中危险情况。
cards.referenceText: The hazardous conditions in air such as lightning strike, hail storm, thunderstorm, volcanic ash and severe turbulence might affect the safety of the flight. If the weather is too bad, it may cause damages to the aircraft. That will seriously affect the safety of the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击、雹暴、雷暴、火山灰以及严重颠簸等空中危险情况都可能会影响飞行安全。如果天气非常恶劣，可能毁坏飞机。这将会严重影响飞行安全。
